blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The heat index in General Santos City reached an extremely dangerous 55°C Tuesday morning, according to the state weather bureau. Based on the interactive map of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), General Santos City’s heat index spiked to 55°C at 7 a.m. It was measured at 52°C at 6 a.m. and 51°C an hour earlier. READ: Here’s how to protect yourself from high heat index, according to DOH Under the extreme danger category, the heat index is greater or equal to 52°C.
